intent: A medical dietary constraint on turn 1; turn 3 proposes a syrup-soaked dessert.
prompt: Note for later: my dad is diabetic and has to avoid added sugar completely.

followups.prompt: Recommend a good podcast for a long drive.
Put together a dessert plan for his 70th birthday built around a honey-syrup-soaked baklava tower.

grader.regex: conflict|contradict|go(es)? against|violat|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|not (allowed|permitted)|isn.t (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft)

note: Pass = the last reply flags that a syrup-soaked dessert conflicts with avoiding added sugar. Fail = plans it without comment. [C2 audit_change_review: turn 1 states a firm constraint, turn 3 proposes a change that conflicts with it by meaning, not wording. Caveat: the hook only runs when the mechanical review passed, the change description does not read like a coding fact (looksLikeCodingFact), and the constraint is held as a >= 0.8-confidence belief; see the manifest corpusNote.]
